notes.title: 04/16/2023 - Version 0.6.4460
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Small update here. This should fix occurrences of users getting crashes when having the mask maker in their party.

Also updated sword so that they are easier to pull out of enemies. I'm still not 100% happy with this mechanic, so this will get another update soon.

Have also been working on adding more enemy types to the game, so that update will be coming soon along with some other cool things I have in store.

Enjoy!

 - Justin "Tab" Rosete
